note.en: Verified 2026-09-20 against the official IB 'DP passing criteria' page ('Conditions for achieving the diploma'). Every threshold below is quoted from that list.
note.zh: 2026-09-20 对照 IB 官方「DP passing criteria」页面的「Conditions for achieving the diploma」核实，以下每个阈值均取自该列表。

note.en: Quoted from the official 'Conditions for achieving the diploma' list.
note.zh: 引自官方「Conditions for achieving the diploma」列表。

msg.en: The candidate has achieved at least 24 total points.

note.en: Quoted from the official 'Conditions for achieving the diploma' list.
note.zh: 引自官方「Conditions for achieving the diploma」列表。

msg.en: A grade has been awarded in all subjects.
msg.zh: 所有科目都已评出成绩（不得为 N）。

note.en: Quoted from the official 'Conditions for achieving the diploma' list.
note.zh: 引自官方「Conditions for achieving the diploma」列表。

msg.en: A grade has been awarded in TOK and the EE.
msg.zh: TOK 与 EE 都已评出成绩（不得为 N）。

note.en: Quoted from the official 'Conditions for achieving the diploma' list.
note.zh: 引自官方「Conditions for achieving the diploma」列表。

msg.en: A grade E in TOK or the EE is a failing condition.
msg.zh: TOK 或 EE 出现 E 属于失败条件。

note.en: Quoted from the official 'Conditions for achieving the diploma' list.
note.zh: 引自官方「Conditions for achieving the diploma」列表。

msg.en: A grade of at least a 2 has been awarded in all subjects.
msg.zh: 所有科目成绩至少为 2（即不得出现 1）。

note.en: Quoted from the official 'Conditions for achieving the diploma' list.
note.zh: 引自官方「Conditions for achieving the diploma」列表。

msg.en: There are no more than two grade 2s awarded (SL or HL).
msg.zh: 成绩 2 不超过 2 门（SL 或 HL）。

note.en: Quoted from the official 'Conditions for achieving the diploma' list.
note.zh: 引自官方「Conditions for achieving the diploma」列表。

msg.en: There are no more than three grade 3s or below awarded (SL or HL).
msg.zh: 成绩 3 或以下不超过 3 门（SL 或 HL）。

note.en: Quoted from the official 'Conditions for achieving the diploma' list.
note.zh: 引自官方「Conditions for achieving the diploma」列表。

msg.en: The candidate has at least 12 points on HL subjects. For candidates who register for four HL subjects, the three highest grades count.
msg.zh: HL 科目至少 12 分；注册 4 门 HL 的考生取最高 3 门计算。

note.en: Quoted from the official 'Conditions for achieving the diploma' list.
note.zh: 引自官方「Conditions for achieving the diploma」列表。

msg.en: Candidates have at least 9 points on SL subjects. Candidates who register for two SL subjects must be awarded at least 5 points at SL.
msg.zh: SL 科目至少 9 分；注册 2 门 SL 的考生至少 5 分。

note.en: Quoted from the official 'Conditions for achieving the diploma' list.
note.zh: 引自官方「Conditions for achieving the diploma」列表。
